request: Keep the one-at-a-time route and add one task with many words on the same page.
scope: Additional presentation of existing word activities. No new words, distractors, audio, images, curriculum placement or exercise answers.
placement: Shared GroupRound, reachable both through skill chapters and existing word-group practice. Existing level/reading-condition selections are passed through unchanged.
didacticChecks: One common task, with the same action available for every eligible word; not a menu mixing different exercises.
Existing sourceExerciseId, wordId, sourceLessonIds, targets, distractors and approved media remain attached to every item.
Copying retains the model; heard spelling does not show the answer before help. A completed model audio is participation, not evidence of independent reading.
Each listening row unlocks only after its own stimulus ends. Interrupted or failed audio does not unlock another row.
Words and options stay in place after wrong answers. The learner can choose any row, repeat audio or return to the sequence.
Existing letter building supplies both dragging and tapping. No withdrawn instruction audio or rejected isolated t is introduced.

The sheet is optional independent practice attached to existing lesson goals. It does not silently replace scheduled lesson time or create a new course programme. No fictional classroom observations are recorded.
technicalChecks: Reuse existing ExerciseSurface rendering and answer validation; no parallel exercise engine.
At most one audio stream. Requests are aborted on row/view changes and unmount.
A previously opened sheet keeps drafts and completion while switching views in the same visit. A fresh visit starts a new sheet; existing lesson-route storage is not changed.
No fixed four-word limit: all selected words remain on the scrollable page. A single-word collection keeps the existing single view.

diglinObservation.method: Read the user's open logged-in Chrome menu and attempted to open two exercise entries without submitting answers.
diglinObservation.limitation: Opening exercises redirected to NT2 School. Their current exercise screens could not be re-verified. No DigLin content, media or code copied.

reviewBasis: Woordstap oefenproductie, its content schema and exercise matrix; the existing Taalroute design basis was read locally and on Drive.
limitations: No new learner trial. This is a design/code review and browser verification, not a classroom observation.
Existing bingo, matching and other multiword boards are retained. Text, conversation and other activity families are not all converted to sheets by this change.
Narrow screens scroll vertically instead of shrinking all words into one viewport.
The canonical DigiBord style-reference folder is unavailable. Existing Klink typography, icons and buttons are preserved.
